title: IDC Frontier Cloud Storage Ransomware Simulation

incident.name: IDC Frontier Cloud Storage Ransomware Disaster
incident.summary: Simulates in-flight malicious tamper/deletion attempts against storage archives to verify Write-Once-Read-Many (WORM) and S3 Object Lock compliance.
references: IDC Frontier East Japan ransomware disaster: 495 enterprise tenants suffered unrecoverable cloud data loss.

target_dir.description: Path to local directory or storage mount point being evaluated for immutable WORM protection.

steps.name: WORM Tamper & Deletion Compliance Check
steps.description: Performs overwrite, truncate, and delete operations against test archive file.

recommendations.remediation: Deploy Komagu Boilerplate 3 (Immutable Backup & DR) with AWS S3 Object Lock in COMPLIANCE mode and cross-region replication to prevent unrecoverable cloud ransomware wiping.
recommendations.passed: Storage assets strictly adhere to immutable WORM policy.
